question:
I am trying to set up unit testing in my dbt project using the dbt package dbt_datamocktool. My test data lies in the path tests/test_data/*.

I have configured multiple seed paths in my project.yml file as follows:

seed-paths: [ "seeds", "tests/test_data" ]

So my project looks something like this:

├── seeds
│   ├── data.csv
├── tests
│   ├── test_data
│   │   ├── test_data.csv

I want to separate both seed directories to have all my testing resources in one place.

With my test-data directory in place, I also want to create this data within a specific database schema (e.g. <schema-name>_test_data).

In the project.yml file it is possible to configure specific schemas for different directories:

seeds:
  project_name:
    +schema: seeds
    sub-directory:
      +schema: sub_directory

But somehow, I am not able to add my specific test-data directory to this. At least I did not find any information on how to this.

Maybe someone can help me with this :)

Thanks!

I tried adding additional configuration to the seeds section in my project.yml file, but this either resulted in a warning like Configuration paths exist in your dbt_project.yml file which do not apply to any resources. or nothing happened at all.
title: How to create seed models in different schemas when having multiple seed paths
answer:
The issue you have is that you have specified a path in seed-paths which, despite it's name, expects a list of directories.

Change the seed paths list to

seed-paths: [ "seeds", "tests" ]

and then your dbt_project.yml to

seeds:
  project_name:
    +schema: seeds
    test_data:
      +schema: some_other_schema

The above config makes "seeds" the default schema for seed files but overrides it for files in tests\test_data to "some_other_schema".
